scripts.setup: docker compose up --build -d db && docker compose run --rm api npm run db:setup --workspace api && docker compose up --build -d
scripts.setup:migrate: docker compose exec api npm run db:migrate --workspace api
scripts.setup:seed: docker compose exec api npm run db:seed --workspace api
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage --workspace api && npm run test:coverage --workspace web && node scripts/coverage-summary.mjs
